name: Decoy Switch
description: If your Queen is pinned to your King by an enemy Rook, Bishop, or Queen, she may swap positions with any unpinned allied Pawn or minor piece within 2 squares of her (if swapping with a Pawn, both squares must be between the 2nd and 7th ranks, placing that ally into the pin line in the Queen's place).

name: Clear the Way
description: If your Queen is cramped and has 5 or fewer legal moves, she may push 1 adjacent allied non-King piece 1 or 2 empty squares directly away from her along that rank, file, or diagonal (allied Pawns must land between the 2nd and 7th ranks; cannot expose your King to check).

name: Escort Screen
description: If at least 3 of the squares immediately adjacent to your Queen are controlled by enemy pieces, she may pull 1 allied Pawn or minor piece within 2 squares along an unobstructed line onto an empty square adjacent to her (allied Pawns must land between the 2nd and 7th ranks; cannot expose your King to check).

name: Vanguard Tow
description: If your Queen is threatening an enemy piece that is defended by another enemy piece, she may slide onto an empty square and simultaneously advance 1 allied Pawn on an adjacent file 1 square straight forward onto an empty square (standard 8th-rank promotion and King-safety rules apply).

name: Royal Swap

card_description: If an allied non-King piece is directly adjacent (orthogonally or diagonally) to your Queen, your Queen may swap positions with that adjacent ally (if swapping with an allied Pawn, both squares must lie between the 2nd and 7th ranks, and the swap must not expose your King to check).
